stem.text: Water waves of wavelength $\lambda$ are incident normally on an obstacle with a narrow gap. The width of the gap is equal to $\lambda$. The waves from the gap emerge over an angle $\theta$, as shown.

stem.alt: Plane water waves moving right towards an obstacle with a narrow gap, with circular wavefronts emerging on the right; labels incident water waves, emerging water waves, lambda and theta.

stem.text: Which changes, if any, occur to $\theta$ and to the wavelength of the emerging waves?
